name: Yamaha YZ250 (two-stroke)
intro: Yamaha's long-running 250 two-stroke. Premix, a top end that wears and no lights.

add.title: Check compression and the top end
add.instructions: Do a compression test. Low numbers mean the piston and rings are due. Pull and clean the power valve while you are in there.
add.reason: A tired top end and a gummed power valve are the most common problems on a used two-stroke.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual. There is no oil tank.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
